measurement_description: The paper evaluates model harmlessness using the Korean Large Language Model Trustworthiness Benchmark Data. While the license agreement's ethical use clause prohibits generating discriminatory content based on religion, the benchmark subcategories detailed in the paper (e.g., bias and hate related to gender, race, political affiliation) do not explicitly include religion as a measured category.
